versioning.plugin_platform: SemVer. Bump major for breaking API or manifest contract changes, minor for backward-compatible API or catalog additions, patch for documentation and bug-fix level corrections.
versioning.manifest: Integer contract version. Bump only when plugin.yaml parsing or required semantics become incompatible.
versioning.app: DAP application release version. Managed separately from plugin platform docs.
versioning.plugin: Individual plugin version. Managed in each plugin repository and catalog ref.
